# AI for Marketing — Exercise Sheets

Work in tables of 3–4. Each lab ends with something written down that you take back to work.

## Lab 1 — Map your pipeline

*Module 1: Content pipeline audit · about 12 minutes*

**With demo 1** (`python demos/01_pipeline_audit.py`): Map your own last three pieces of content. Where did each wait longest? Is that a writing problem or an approval problem?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 2 — Build the kit

*Module 2: Brand voice kit · about 18 minutes*

**With demo 2** (`python demos/02_brand_voice_kit.py`): Build your kit: three exemplars, ten banned phrases, one sentence-length rule. Test a draft from last month. Would you have published it?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 3 — One piece → six assets

*Module 3: Repurposing engine · about 18 minutes*

**With demo 3** (`python demos/03_repurposing_engine.py`): Take one real long-form piece. Produce the six assets, then run the consistency check by eye: did any number, name or claim drift?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 4 — Message matrix

*Module 4: Ideation and audience research · about 18 minutes*

**With demo 4** (`python demos/04_message_matrix.py`): Bring 20 real customer quotes (support tickets, reviews, call notes). Tag them. Which persona did you imagine that the data does not support?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 5 — Report read-out

*Module 5: SEO and analytics · about 12 minutes*

**With demo 5** (`python demos/05_seo_clusters_and_readout.py`): Export 30 of your real search queries and last month's channel table. Let AI write the read-out, then verify each sentence against the numbers.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 6 — Team SOP + pre-publish checklist

*Module 6: Guardrails and SOP · about 18 minutes*

**With demo 6** (`python demos/06_prepublish_checklist.py`): Agree your own regulated-words list with legal. Run last month's three most important pieces through the check.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.
